name: Split-Minded
source:
You play as a voice within the head of a typical VN main character.
Unfortunately, as a voice within Kei (the main character)’s head, you’re not alone, and even worse the other voices are willing to use force to take control of our poor MC.

But maybe, if you can keep control, you can help the main character find love…
…or you can just let the others take control and see what hilarious and/or horrifying antics they get up to while in control.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221101002808/https://farawayvision.itch.io/split-minded]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演的是典型VN主角头脑中的声音。
不幸的是，作为Kei（主角）头脑中的一个声音，你并不孤单，更糟糕的是，其他声音愿意使用武力来控制我们可怜的MC。

但也许，如果你能控制住，你就能帮助主角找到爱情……
……或者你可以让其他人控制，看看他们在控制时会做出什么搞笑和/或可怕的滑稽动作。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221101002808/https://farawayvision.itch.io/split-minded]itch.io[/url]]
